verdicts.threshold: Project avoidance: >= 5 km from flammable/toxic/explosive storage.
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: A7 — Project avoidance: >= 5 km from flammable/toxic/explosive storage.

verdicts.threshold: Project avoidance: >= 8 km from hazardous-cloud sources.
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: A8 — Project avoidance: >= 8 km from hazardous-cloud sources.

verdicts.threshold: Project A5: >= 30 km from practice/bombing/firing ranges.

verdicts.threshold: Project A6: >= 8 km from ammunition storage.
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: A6 — Project A6: >= 8 km from ammunition storage.

verdicts.justification: not_triggered: A10 — Project screening: PGA(2475 yr) > 0.5 g fails Phase 2.

verdicts.threshold: Capable fault within score-5 pivot distance.
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: E1 — Capable fault within score-5 pivot distance.

verdicts.threshold: High or very-high liquefaction susceptibility with no engineering remedy.
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: E2 — High or very-high liquefaction susceptibility with no engineering remedy.

verdicts.threshold: Slope above the SSG-9 mitigable envelope (score-5 pivot).
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: E3 — Slope above the SSG-9 mitigable envelope (score-5 pivot).

verdicts.threshold: Holocene volcano within score-5 pivot distance.
verdicts.justification: inconclusive: E4 — Holocene volcano within score-5 pivot distance.

verdicts.threshold: A9 caution: measured sea-coast distance is < 10 km at < 50 m AMSL, or positive storm-surge/tsunami proxy evidence exists for a low-elevation site. Missing coast distance alone is a data gap, not coastal exposure; confirm coastal flooding and tsunami exposure in Stage 3.
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: A9 — A9 caution: measured sea-coast distance is < 10 km at < 50 m AMSL, or positive storm-surge/tsunami proxy evidence exists for a low-elevation site. Missing coast distance alone is a data gap, not coastal exposure; confirm coastal flooding and tsunami exposure in Stage 3.

verdicts.threshold: Project avoidance: >= 4 km OR vertical separation >= 30.5 m (100 ft).
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: A11 — Project avoidance: >= 4 km OR vertical separation >= 30.5 m (100 ft).

verdicts.threshold: Cooling source > 10 km AND WRI Aqueduct water stress High / Extremely High; flag for cooling-tower or dry/hybrid cooling design review (SSG-35 §4.9 ultimate-heat-sink characterisation).
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: A16 — Cooling source > 10 km AND WRI Aqueduct water stress High / Extremely High; flag for cooling-tower or dry/hybrid cooling design review (SSG-35 §4.9 ultimate-heat-sink characterisation).

verdicts.threshold: Project A13: transmission >= reference SMR net MWe within feasible distance.
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: A13 — Project A13: transmission >= reference SMR net MWe within feasible distance.

verdicts.threshold: Project A14: heavy-haul access >= 700 t segment capacity.
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: A14 — Project A14: heavy-haul access >= 700 t segment capacity.

verdicts.threshold: Project A15: >= 14 ha canonical site area.
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: A15 — Project A15: >= 14 ha canonical site area.

verdicts.threshold: Natura 2000 polygon overlap OR WDPA IUCN Ia/Ib/II polygon overlap OR international-designation polygon overlap.
verdicts.justification: not_triggered: E7 — Natura 2000 polygon overlap OR WDPA IUCN Ia/Ib/II polygon overlap OR international-designation polygon overlap.
